notes.title: Coming Soon: Cool Cucumber Cricket Manager
Download the Playtest.
notes.content:
I'm doing a playtest because I'm a solo dev and I need people to play the game and tell me what to fix.
It's really just the whole game there's no limit to on the content so you why the hell not.
All you need to do is click join playtest on the store page and then the download button will appear.
Have fun out there (how could you not, it's cricket but with cards).
